description: Insider transactions from SEC Form 4 filings: who (officer, director, 10% owner) bought or sold a company's stock, with transaction code and plain label, shares, price, value, shares owned afterwards, dates and the SEC filing link. Requires at least one of ticker, insider or company. Defaults to open-market buys and sells over the last 7 days (max 14). Official EDGAR data. Max 10 rows per call.

days.description: Filed in the last N days (default 7).

min_value_usd.description: Minimum shares x price in USD.

transaction_type.description: buy = open-market purchases, sell = open-market sales, buy_sell (default) = both, all = every non-derivative code.

name: find_insider_trades
title: Insider buys and sells (SEC Form 4)
